article.summary_es: Faith Center for Human Services, Inc. es una despensa de alimentos y comedor de sopa en Brooklyn, aparece en el mapa Food Help NYC de la ciudad. Abre los sábados.
article.summary_en: Faith Center for Human Services, Inc. is a food pantry and soup kitchen in Brooklyn, listed on the City's Food Help NYC map. It is open on Saturdays.
